name: FOX WOODWORK & CRAFTS INC
old_description: Creates exceptional living spaces, fulfilling clients' dreams through expert craftsmanship and innovative designs that go beyond expectations.
about:
Fox Woodwork & Crafts Inc. operates from Billerica, Massachusetts, serving the Greater Boston area with custom woodworking and renovation services. The company grew from a passion for craftsmanship and a commitment to transforming residential and commercial spaces.

The shop specializes in complete renovations, kitchen remodeling, custom cabinet manufacturing, and stair construction. Projects are built using wood, metal, glass, and premium finishes, with each piece tailored to client specifications. The team handles projects ranging from single custom cabinets to full-scale renovations.

Clients include homeowners in Boston, Cambridge, and Somerville, as well as commercial offices seeking stylish, functional spaces. The company serves both residential and commercial sectors, delivering projects such as custom kitchen cabinets, modern furniture pieces, and feature staircases.

Fox Woodwork emphasizes creativity and innovation, impeccable quality, and trusting relationships as core principles. The company backs its work with warranties on services and products, promises on-time delivery, and leaves job sites clean upon completion.
